programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Looking at how a Sprocker spaniel's sense of smell and the protective instincts of an Anatolian shepherd dog are playing a vital role in the conservation of endangered species. programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Part one of two. Biologist Patrick Aryee explores how cats have evolved throughout the millennia, learning to thrive in inhospitable environments, as well as becoming the world's most popular pet. In the first edition there is spectacular footage of caracals jumping three metres to catch flying birds, and a rare Bornean bay cat, which was thought to have been extinct. Patrick finds out how tigers made the transition from South-east Asia's steamy jungles to the -40C temperatures of Siberia, and meets 'lion whisperer' Kevin Richardson.

programme.title: Big Cats: An Amazing Animal Family
programme.desc: Patrick Aryee concludes his two-part exploration of the feline family tree, revealing how the Canadian lynx learned to thrive in the snow and spread out, evolving and inhabiting new parts of the Americas. In Belize, he mounts an experiment that showcases the margay's supersharp senses and gravity-defying acrobatics, and heads to the training track with a cheetah to find out what speed it is capable of. Finally, Patrick tells the story of the cat's domestication in Essaouira, Morocco, believed to be one of the first places where one particular species first gave up life in the wild in return for food, warmth, security and a home.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough employs the latest technologies to explore the violence, rivalries and deadly weaponry existing within the world of bugs. This first episode examines the survival tactics of its terrifying residents including killer ants, trap-setting spiders and beetles with the ability to shoot boiling chemicals at their enemies.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster continues his bug-eyed view of the world of creepy-crawlies, revealing how predators defuse the defences of their prey. Highlights include the cockroach wasp, busy preparing a tasty - and very live - treat for its young, the whirligig beetle, which employs a water-based radar system, and the jumping portia spider, which feeds on other arachnids.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A further selection of creepy-crawly close-ups, focusing on courtship in the bug world. Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: David Attenborough shifts the focus to bugs that prefer co-operation rather than conflict. They include burrowing cockroaches, the suitably named social spiders - which share a 30-metre web - the queen bee and her happy hive of workers and green ants pulling together to build a nest.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his close-up examination of the creepy-crawly world, shifting focus to the bugs' ultimate invention - the colony. Key residents of these minuscule mega-cities include honey bees, termites, leafcutter ants - who have a knack for farming - and their Argentine cousins, members of a community so vast it spans an entire continent.

programme.title: Nature's Dress Code: Who Wears What and Why?
programme.desc: Every living creature, from the amoeba to the blue whale, needs a suitable coat. Dive deep into the fashion styles of the natural world with this colourful documentary.

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli
programme.desc: Documentary about a group of elusive chimpanzees living in the Fongoli region of Senegal, on the southern edge of the Sahara Desert. It's the hottest, driest place in the world that chimps can live and they really shouldn't be here - so how do they survive?

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist and film-maker explores the many varieties of plant life housed at the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, and explains what they reveal about the natural world and the development of life on Earth. He begins inside the establishment's Palm House, whose climate has been engineered to simulate conditions found in rainforests, charting the evolution of plants that grow in the world's wettest regions and investigating how flowering plants spread across the globe so rapidly.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist explores how the plants at Kew Gardens change through the seasons and demonstrates the surprising properties of several species, including the predatory pond-dwelling bladderwort utricularia and a fungus that appears to be capable of mind control. He also discusses the largest single organism on the planet, visits the world's biggest flower and explains how plants and insects can communicate using scents and music.

programme.title: David Attenborough's Kingdom of Plants
programme.desc: The naturalist concludes his exploration of the Royal Botanic Gardens in Kew, west London, by examining plants that have evolved to minimise their dependence on water, enabling them to survive in the world's driest environments. He witnesses a cactus blooming at midnight, tells the story of the spectacular flowering of the Agave franzosinii, and visits the Millennium Seed Bank, a facility designed to save plants from future extinction.

programme.title: Secrets of the Enchanted Waters
programme.desc: A journey through mystical lakes, where life adapts, survives and transforms, while witnessing the power of ancient beasts like the snapping turtle and walking tall with flamingos.

programme.title: Jellyfish: The Ocean's New Rulers

programme.title: David Attenborough Meets Obama
programme.desc: Another chance to see Barack Obama's conversation, recorded in May 2015, with renowned naturalist and film-maker David Attenborough. In a twist on usual convention, the then-US president took the role of interviewer, quizzing Attenborough about his thoughts on the future of the planet, their shared passion for nature, and potential ways to protect the environment. Also includes behind-the-scenes footage from Sir David's latest project on the Great Barrier Reef, as well as highlights from throughout the veteran broadcaster's career.

programme.title: Hanste Khelte
programme.desc: Three friends who don't take their life seriously are suspended from college so they decide to take revenge on the principal. On reaching his house they find that someone has already killed him.

programme.title: Aur Pyaar Ho Gaya
programme.desc: When Ashi's father arranges her marriage to Switzerland-based Rohit, she decides to learn more about him first. But things go awry when she meets Bobby and mistakenly believes he is Rohit.

programme.title: Karz Chukana Hai
programme.desc: Vishwanath loses his job and forces his elder son to earn money. His greed and pride push the family into emotional turmoil, testing love and resilience.

programme.title: Deewaar
programme.desc: Two Bombay brothers: Vijay the smuggler and Ravi the policeman. Father's disgrace, mother's hardship, and a split path push them toward crime, loyalty, and law.

programme.title: Dilwale
programme.desc: Raj and Meera's love is torn apart by their families' mafia rivalry. Years later, fate reunites them when their younger siblings fall in love, giving them another chance at their own lost romance.

programme.title: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
programme.desc: Rocky, a Punjabi, falls in love with Rani, a Bengali journalist. Facing strong family opposition, they decide to live with each other's families for three months to prove their love before marriage.

programme.title: Andhadhun
programme.desc: Akash, a pianist faking blindness, accidentally witnesses a former actor's murder and gets caught in a web of unexpected troubles and danger.

programme.title: Kidnap
programme.desc: Kabir kidnaps Sonia to take revenge on businessman Raina, who falsely accused him. As secrets unfold, Kabir's plan reveals deeper wounds and a thirst for redemption.

programme.title: Kotwal Saab
programme.desc: Bharat arrests Mahesh, a corrupt henchman. But Mahesh reveals a shocking truth about Bharat's wife, turning the officer's world upside down and testing his loyalty and love.

programme.title: Sapne Saajan Ke
programme.desc: Shalini, who has always wanted her daughter Jyoti to marry a rich man, is happy that she has found Deepak to be her life partner. But no one knows that he is only pretending to be wealthy.

programme.title: Naqaab
programme.desc: Sophia is engaged to Karan, a devoted millionaire. But when she meets Vicky, her true love, she begins a secret affair that threatens everything she thought she wanted.

programme.title: Khuda Gawah
programme.desc: Pashtun warrior Badshah Khan fights enemies and faces trials across years to win Benazir's love while upholding honor and justice.

programme.title: Govinda Naam Mera
programme.desc: Govinda Waghmare feels trapped in his marriage to a domineering wife and finds solace in his beautiful girlfriend. But his double life soon spirals into chaos, landing him in hilarious trouble.

programme.title: Kapoor & Sons
programme.desc: Kapoor and Sons.

programme.title: Aan - Men At Work
programme.desc: Criminals terrorize Mumbai while the weak police fail. A determined new DCP steps in, vowing to fight crime and restore safety to the city.

programme.title: Jeene Do: Let Us Live
programme.desc: An ambitious cyclist arrives in Mumbai for a championship final, but his world flips when he uncovers his family's painful past, driving him into a dangerous quest for vengeance.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: Rakesh gets traumatized every time his mother comes near him. He gets adopted by a Christian couple and becomes Rocky.

programme.title: Mohabbat
programme.desc: Shekhar falls for Roopa and visits her father with his family, but when his stepmother demands dowry, Roopa's father is insulted and decides to marry his daughter elsewhere, sparking conflict.

programme.title: Chor Ke Ghar Chor
programme.desc: Rajkumari Ophelia hires a thug to steal a Devi Maa idol for luck, but the goddess's wrath awakens, bringing chaos and destruction to the lives of two noble families.

programme.title: Fighter
programme.desc: Shamsher 'Patty' Pathania achieves his dream of joining the Indian Air Force. Facing intense trials and personal doubts, he must push his limits and prove himself as a true hero in the skies.

programme.title: Trishul
programme.desc: Business tycoon Raj Kumar abandons Shanti, his first love, to marry a rich heiress. Later, Vijay, Raj and Shanti's illegitimate son, seeks revenge from Raj for the injustice meted out to his mother.

programme.title: Baghban
programme.desc: An elderly couple wish their children to care for them in their old age. But their children see and treat them as a burden, and they must struggle to regain their worth and dignity.

programme.title: Chennai Express
programme.desc: Rahul sets out to immerse his grandfather's ashes at Rameshwaram, but after helping runaway bride Meena board a train, he ends up clashing with her dangerous criminal family.

programme.title: Inkaar
programme.desc: Rahul, a CEO, is accused of sexual harassment by his protege Maya. As an internal committee investigates, both are given a chance to present their sides, revealing hidden truths and motives.

programme.title: Bumper Draw
programme.desc: Sunderlal and Farooq befriend each other in odd circumstances, but when they meet wealthy Pestonji, they hatch a cunning plan to use him to escape their money troubles.

programme.title: Jug Jug Jeeyo
programme.desc: A family wedding becomes a backdrop for joy, romance, and celebration, but also exposes miscommunication, hidden affairs, and doubts that threaten to break marriages apart.

programme.title: Chori Mera Kam
programme.desc: Bhola Nath, a petty thief and secretly Kumar's son, grows up amid crime. With Sharmii, he encounters rival gangsters, a bestselling manuscript, and dangerous secrets.

programme.title: War
programme.desc: Kabir, a secret agent, goes rogue after a mission to catch a terrorist goes awry. However, his boss sends Khalid, another agent and his student, to track him down.

programme.title: Welcome
programme.desc: Two thugs meet Rajiv, who belongs to a respectable family, and want to fix their sister's wedding with him. However, when Rajiv's uncle refuses to the match, a series of hilarious situations occur.

programme.title: Dilwale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge
programme.desc: Raj, a rich, carefree, happy-go-lucky second generation NRI, follows Simran to India to win over her strict father and marry her.

programme.title: Gabbar Is Back

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The masked avenger stalks the streets of Gotham City, waging a nightly war against the criminal element. However, he may have met his match when the city's crime syndicate is taken over by the crazed Joker, who plans to poison the populace with toxic chemicals. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure, starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The masked hero returns to face the Penguin, a grotesque crime boss dwelling in the sewers who conspires with a corrupt businessman to make himself mayor. When the tycoon tries to kill his secretary, she returns as vengeful vigilante Catwoman, who soon forms an intense relationship with the dark knight in both their costumed and real identities. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure sequel, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The masked crimefighter takes on the twin threats of disfigured maniac Two-Face and insane genius the Riddler, who are plotting to control the brains of the entire world. Meanwhile, an acrobat whose family has been murdered by Two-Face steps up to join Batman in his fight against evil. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Nicole Kidman, Jim Carrey and Chris O'Donnell.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell.
